violations: Table 7 (p.9): Nitrate as N over the MCL of 10 mg/L. Range has been 11-12 mg/L at Well 3 and 13-20 mg/L at Well 2; duration 10/16/25 - 10/22/25. Actions taken: installed RO systems at point of use in individual homes. Health effects language for nitrate (infants below six months may become seriously ill...) is included.
extraction_notes: State small-water-system CCR template. Data tables: Table 1-3 on PDF page 4, Table 4 on pages 5-6, Table 5 and Table 6 on page 6, Table 7 on pages 7-8, Table 8 on page 8, violations Table 7 on page 9. Tables 3-5 are headed 'WELL 03' and Tables 6-8 'WELL 02', used as source_group; Table 2 lead/copper (customer taps) has no well label. Table 1 (E. coli) was left as unfilled template text ('[Enter No.]') and was omitted. The 'Level Detected' column is not labeled as an average, so value_basis is 'level detected' (or 'highest single result' for Well 02 nitrate, which prints two dated results). Several rows have a range that does not match the level detected (Well 02 hardness 290 vs 270, barium 50 vs 230, fluoride 0.18 vs 0.15); copied as printed. Barium is printed in mg/L (230 and 50) against an MCL of 1 without being flagged as a violation, so the unit is almost certainly mislabeled ug/L; copied as printed and flagged in notes. TDS rows have no unit printed; mg/L assumed from the table. PHG column for secondary rows is printed '-'.
